lines.en: What had happened to the writer's bag?
After I had had lunch at a village pub, I looked for my bag.
lines.zh: 我在一家乡村酒吧吃过午饭后，就去找我的包。

lines.en: I had left it on a chair beside the door and now it wasn't there!
lines.zh: 我把它放在门旁边的一把椅子上，现在它不在那里了！

lines.en: As I was looking for it, the landlord came in.
lines.zh: 当我正在找它的时候，房东进来了。

lines.en: 'Did you have a good meal?' he asked.
'Yes, thank you,' I answered, 'but I can't pay the bill. I haven't got my bag.'
lines.zh: “是的，谢谢你，”我回答说，“但我付不了账单。我没有我的包。”

lines.en: The landlord smiled and immediately went out.
In a few minutes he returned with my bag and gave it back to me.
lines.zh: 几分钟后，他带着我的包回来了，并把它还给了我。

lines.en: 'My dog had taken it into the garden. He often does this!'
lines.zh: “我的狗把它叼到花园里去了。它经常这样做！”
